"""Validate a fresh P9-3.3 export using only its numerical source and assets."""
import argparse
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import importlib.metadata
import json
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
import platform
import stat
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import zipfile


def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--repo', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output', type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    root, output = args.repo.resolve(), args.output.resolve()
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    followup = 'implementation/phase-9-grcv4/evidence/P9-3.3/audit-1-followup/inputs.json'
    subject = json.loads((root / followup).read_text())['subject']
    numerical = {p: h for p, h in subject['tracked_file_sha256'].items()
                 if p.startswith(('src/', 'tests/', 'specs/')) or p in ('pyproject.toml', 'README.md', 'LICENSE')}
    consumer = '''
import importlib, json, pathlib, sys, unittest
root = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
sys.path[:0] = [str(root / 'src'), str(root)]
modules = ['pygrc.models.' + name for name in ('grc_v4', 'grc_v4_transport', 'grc_v4_step', 'grc_v4_geometry', 'grc_v4_state', 'grc_v4_profile', 'grc_v4_codec')]
modules += ['tests.models.' + name for name in ('test_grc_v4_geometry', 'test_grc_v4_profile', 'test_grc_v4_step', 'test_grc_v4_transport')]
origins = {}
for name in modules:
    path = pathlib.Path(importlib.import_module(name).__file__).resolve()
    assert path.is_relative_to(root), (name, str(path))
    origins[name] = str(path.relative_to(root))
from pygrc.models import grc_v4_codec as codec
from importlib import resources
asset_root = resources.files(codec._ASSET_PACKAGE)
assert pathlib.Path(str(asset_root)).resolve().is_relative_to(root)
names = [
    'tests.models.test_grc_v4_step.ResourceBoundaryTests.test_zero_rounded_residual_can_hide_exact_stored_sum_growth',
    'tests.models.test_grc_v4_step.ResourceBoundaryTests.test_cycle_circulation_with_same_resource_cannot_borrow_selection',
    'tests.models.test_grc_v4_transport.ContinuityTests.test_repeated_primitive_transfers_can_hide_exact_stored_sum_growth',
    'tests.models.test_grc_v4_step.ResourceReconstructionTests.test_resource_reconstruction_outside_checkout_with_three_hash_seeds',
]
result = unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromNames(names))
assert result.testsRun == 4 and not result.skipped
print(json.dumps({'loaded_origins': origins, 'tests_run': result.testsRun, 'skips': len(result.skipped), 'failures': len(result.failures), 'errors': len(result.errors), 'passed': result.wasSuccessful()}))
raise SystemExit(not result.wasSuccessful())
'''
    inputs = {'numerical_subject': {'inputs': followup, 'sha256': sha((root / followup).read_bytes())},
              'runner': {'name': Path(__file__).name, 'source': Path(__file__).read_text()},
              'consumer': consumer,
              'scope': 'Export and outside-checkout numerical consumption before retaining this result. Later document/evidence retention does not change the numerical subject.'}
    (output / 'inputs.json').write_text(json.dumps(inputs, indent=2) + '\n')
    record = {'schema': 'phase9_leaf_run_v1', 'iteration_id': 'P9-3.3', 'status': 'running',
              'started_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'python': sys.version,
              'platform': platform.platform(), 'subject_inputs': 'inputs.json',
              'dependencies': sorted(f"{d.metadata['Name']}=={d.version}" for d in importlib.metadata.distributions()),
              'replay_argv': ['<venv-python>', '<extracted-runner>', '--repo', '<checkout>', '--output', '<fresh-output>'],
              'commands': [], 'claim_ceiling': 'Numerical packet consumption only; no standalone historical authority replay or additional clean package environment.'}
    def retain():
        (output / 'run.json').write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
    def run(argv, cwd):
        print('Executing', ' '.join(argv[:6]), flush=True)
        p = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=cwd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=240)
        record['commands'].append({'argv': argv, 'cwd': str(cwd), 'exit_status': p.returncode,
                                   'stdout': p.stdout, 'stderr': p.stderr})
        retain()
        if p.returncode:
            raise RuntimeError('Packet verification command failed')
        return p.stdout
    retain()
    try:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='p933-packet-') as temp:
            scratch = Path(temp)
            packet = scratch / 'review.zip'
            exported = json.loads(run([sys.executable, '-m', 'tests.models.test_grc_v4_step',
                                       '--export-p933-audit', str(packet)], root))
            extracted = scratch / 'extracted'
            with zipfile.ZipFile(packet) as archive:
                manifest = json.loads(archive.read('BUNDLE-MANIFEST.json'))
                entries = {e['path']: e for e in manifest['files']}
                assert len(entries) == len(manifest['files'])
                assert set(archive.namelist()) == set(entries) | {'BUNDLE-MANIFEST.json'}
                assert len(archive.namelist()) == len(set(archive.namelist()))
                for info in archive.infolist():
                    p = PurePosixPath(info.filename)
                    assert not p.is_absolute() and '..' not in p.parts
                    assert not stat.S_ISLNK(info.external_attr >> 16)
                    data = archive.read(info)
                    if info.filename in entries:
                        entry = entries[info.filename]
                        assert len(data) == entry['bytes'] and sha(data) == entry['sha256']
                    target = extracted / info.filename
                    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                    target.write_bytes(data)
            assert not (extracted / '.git').exists()
            assert all(entries[p]['sha256'] == h for p, h in numerical.items())
            result = json.loads(run([sys.executable, '-I', '-c', consumer, str(extracted)], scratch))
            actual = {'export': exported, 'manifest_members_verified': len(entries),
                      'numerical_subject_files_verified': len(numerical), 'git_directory_absent': True,
                      'consumer': result}
            (output / 'actual.json').write_text(json.dumps(actual, indent=2) + '\n')
        record['source_unchanged_during_run'] = all(sha((root / p).read_bytes()) == h for p, h in numerical.items())
        assert record['source_unchanged_during_run']
        record['status'] = 'passed'
    except Exception as error:
        record['status'], record['error'] = 'failed', repr(error)
    record['completed_utc'] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    record['artifacts'] = {p.name: sha(p.read_bytes()) for p in output.iterdir() if p.name != 'run.json'}
    retain()
    return int(record['status'] != 'passed')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    raise SystemExit(main())
